evals.name: explain-flow
evals.prompt: I just want to review how the weekly score gets computed end to end — the path from the report into the calculator. Point Vantage at the lines that show that flow so I can walk through it in nvim.
evals.expected_output: A .vantage/walkthrough.json with pointers spanning report.lua (the total_score call) and calculator.lua (total_score + the M.add call), each with a matching anchor and a one-line description.

evals.name: bonus-logic
evals.prompt: Mark up where the bonus value gets added in the calculator, and where that total ends up flowing into the report, so I can review those exact spots in my editor.
evals.expected_output: A .vantage/walkthrough.json pointing at calculator.lua M.add / the value+bonus line and at the report.lua line that consumes the score, anchors matching the live lines.

evals.name: specific-file
evals.prompt: Create a walkthrough of report.lua — I want to see in my editor how build_report puts its result together.
evals.expected_output: A .vantage/walkthrough.json whose pointers all target report.lua (build_report, the score call, the returned table), with matching anchors and short descriptions.
